require human-readable, domain-specific examples

Experts assess, regenerate, or remove formats
add universal JSON/XML/CSV/Markdown/YAML back

detailed real-world task + exact format configuration
include dummy context or permission to improvise

Humans verify, edit, remove, or regenerate each item

use each model's official prompt format

missing any requirement fails the whole item
report format accuracy; human check agrees 84/100
